gen-fs-bonny-nunito-sans: Literary through and through, Bonny sets tight lines with moderate stroke contrast and gaping curves, while Nunito Sans stays soft beside it. Refined meets gentle.
gen-fs-bonny-poppins: Poppins reads modern and clean, with tall sturdy lowercase and strokes that never flicker between heavy and light. Bonny does refinement, a restrained thick-thin play; Poppins does uniform clarity.
gen-righteous-gf-yaldevi: Righteous bends thin steel rod into bowls that fill the line. Yaldevi follows in plain sans-serif form, with outsized lowercase and an e that opens clearly, so long paragraphs go down easily.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-tasa-explorer: TASA Explorer ends its curves like brush strokes lifted early, giving a clean, approachable texture throughout. And Chubbo, drawn like marker with no stroke contrast at all, keeps the whole page casual and inviting.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-savate: Savate has a tall rounded o that nearly matches its capital. Against Warnes, with its stretched tracking and tapering ink strokes, the pair's strongest quality is how expressive boldness meets contemporary restraint.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-multani: Futuristic and smooth as a pen plotter, Audiowide leads. Audiowide delivers tech-flavored heading punch with tile-like glyphs, while Noto Sans Multani handles the reading with a lofty x-height and an open-gapped e.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-new: Zen Kaku Gothic New keeps its curves open and its stroke ends as wide as the middle, with no hairlines or swells anywhere. Oswald's tightly knit rows add confident strength above.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-zen-maru-gothi: Marker-line boldness with daylight in every curve, that's Red Hat Display, and Zen Maru Gothic follows with a smooth read that never snags on a closed bowl. The heading earns its keep big and brief.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-tiktok-sans: Unica One draws every stroke at one thickness, commanding and distinctive. TikTok Sans answers with x-height rising near cap height and a spacious c, so the two sit together firmly.
gen-irish-grover-gf-sulphur-point: Sulphur Point reads neutral and sturdy, its bulky lowercase held by a marker-like line with open gaps in c, e, s and a. And Irish Grover adds fun, organic heft above, with softly varied strokes that stay friendly through a long page.
